title: FlowCell Setup Organization profile v3
description: A folder tree plus per-folder file-type assignments, optional program folders, and optional post-route folder cleanup. `folders` is an ordered flat list of project-relative paths: that order is the routing order, and a file goes to the first folder whose effective extensions contain its own. `programFolders` attaches a program file group to a root-level folder that is only created when matching files are actually present, optionally organized by a nested profile.

recycleOtherFolders.description: After file routing, send folders not used by this profile to the Recycle Bin when they are empty. Folders containing an unmoved file are preserved, and profile-authored ignored folders are always protected.

recyclePreviousIgnoredFolders.description: When empty non-profile-folder cleanup is enabled, also recycle folders listed as ignored by the previous project marker when the current profile no longer owns them. Their contents are not routed first; all current profile folders remain protected.

programFolders.description: Program file groups that get their own root-level folder.

path.description: Project-relative folder path, or "." for the project root itself. The root entry cannot be ignored: ignoring everything would leave nothing to organize.

groupIds.description: References into the shared file-group namespace. Editing a group changes routing everywhere it is used.

fileTypes.description: Extensions assigned directly to this folder, on top of any referenced groups.

ignored.description: When true the folder and its whole subtree are excluded from the recursive scan and nothing is ever moved out of it.

catchAll.description: When true every file no other folder claims is collected here. At most one folder in a profile may set this, and an ignored folder may not.

groupId.description: A program file group. Its label names the created folder.

createInRoot.description: Create the folder at the project root only when at least one file of the group's types exists anywhere in the scan, and route those types into it.

profileId.description: Optional saved profile applied inside the created folder. When that profile assigns this same program group to one of its folders, that folder wins and overrides the program folder root.
